sample_unit: hemodialysis patients in pilot RCT (167 patients used for model development)

links.outcome: IDH events and cumulative SBP decline at IDH onset, AI-assisted management versus conventional care in pilot RCT
links.effect: AI-assisted group had greater reduction in IDH events (MD −8.13, 95% CI −15.64 to −0.62, P=0.034) and cumulative SBP decline at IDH onset (MD −108.69, 95% CI −209.83 to −7.56, P=0.036).
links.quote: Compared to controls, the AI-assisted group had a significantly greater reduction in IDH events (MD − 8.13, 95% CI: − 15.64 to − 0.62, P = 0.034) and a more marked improvement in cumulative SBP decline at IDH onset (MD − 108.69, 95% CI: − 209.83 to − 7.56, P = 0.036).

unlisted_practices: Using a stratified systolic blood pressure threshold to define the intradialytic hypotension prediction target

screen.reason: Prospective randomized controlled trial testing real-time AI-assisted IDH management versus standard care in hemodialysis patients, demonstrating an evaluation of an AI tool in practice rather than testing a specific deployment safeguard/practice modification.
